title: Product Overview, PRD, Roadmap, Pricing & Release Notes - Q2 2026
author: Ava Chen
body:
Overview:

This document consolidates the product overview, high-level PRD, design specs, roadmap & themes, pricing and packaging notes, and release notes for the Product team's Q2 2026 deliverables. It is intended for cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, infra, SRE, go-to-market) and serves as the single source of truth for feature scope, success criteria, and launch operations.

Goals:
- Deliver Redwood Optimize v2 as a productized feature set that reduces per-token inference cost by 18-30% for targeted workloads while maintaining quality SLOs.
- Provide clear pricing/packaging options that enable conversion from self-serve to reserved Dedicated contracts.
- Ship an SDK + Console experience that makes batching/caching recommendations actionable with one-click application.

Scope (in-scope):
1. Redwood Optimize v2 core features: model recommendation engine, quantization profiles, workload-aware batching UI, and evaluation-driven alerts.
2. Pricing & packaging: new tier definitions, usage-based meter changes, and dedicated committed capacity uplift offers.
3. Console UX: Recommendations panel, rollout controls (canary/A-B), and cost simulation modal.
4. Release notes and go-to-market collateral.

Out of scope:
- New hosted model catalog additions (goes to Model Onboarding).
- Major infra redesign (separate infra initiative).

Product Requirements (measurable):
1) Cost reduction: deliver end-to-end median per-token cost savings of >=18% on benchmark workloads with top-3 recommended quantization profiles.
2) Latency SLOs: P95 latency regression <= +5% compared to baseline for generation workloads (sequence length 512).
3) Quality preservation: automated evals show <=1 point drop on key semantic similarity metrics on prod prompt set.
4) Adoption: 20% of free-tier users must engage with recommendations within 30 days of release; 8% convert to paid/provisioned plans within 90 days.
5) Console: recommendations visible and actionable with <=2 clicks; simulation accuracy within 10% of actual billing for tested workloads.

Design & Architecture Notes:
- Core components:
  - Recommendation Engine (stateless service) that consumes telemetry (token distribution, latency, model usage) and outputs candidate model/quantization/batching profiles.
  - Rules Engine for safety: disallow quantization profiles for customers with legal/quality constraints (configurable via customer flags).
  - Console UX: Recommender card, Cost Simulation modal, Rollout control (canary percentage slider, auto-fallback).

- Data & Signals:
  - Input signals: per-route token histogram, average seq length, KV-cache hit rate, error rates, model variant latency profiles.
  - Offline eval harness (applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness) must be wired into the recommendation pipeline for continuous regression checks.

- APIs & Integrations:
  - POST /v2/recommendations (customer-id + workload-spec) -> returns ordered list of candidate profiles (JSON schema v2).
  - Console must call /v2/cost-simulate with sample traffic to render billing delta.

Roadmap & Themes (Q2 2026 - timeline):
- March 2026: Spec sign-off, infra capacity planning, design handoff to eng. Milestone: PRD approved.
- April 2026: Core engine alpha + offline evals integrated. Milestone: Internal alpha demo.
- May 2026: Console integration, cost simulation, and limited beta (selected customers + self-serve opt-in). Milestone: Beta launch.
- June 2026: Public launch, docs, pricing updates, and GTM playbook. Milestone: GA release.

Milestones table (simple):
| Date | Milestone | Owner | Acceptance Criteria |
| 2026-03-15 | PRD sign-off | Product | Approved by reviewers, roadmap updated |
| 2026-04-05 | Engine alpha | Eng-Serving-Runtime | End-to-end recommendations for internal workloads |
| 2026-05-10 | Beta launch | Product + Solutions | 10 customers onboarded, simulation accuracy measured |
| 2026-06-21 | GA release | Product + GTM | Public docs, pricing live, launch blog & sales enablement |

Pricing & Packaging Notes:
- Objective: Create a simple set of options that highlight immediate value while enabling predictable revenue from Dedicated commitments.
- Proposed tiers (concept):
  - Free / Developer: baseline API pricing unchanged; recommendations available but opt-in; usage quotas unchanged.
  - Optimize Starter (metered): +10% surcharge on base tokens for recommendation-enabled savings credits; includes 30K simulation credits/month.
  - Optimize Pro (committed): Monthly committed spend tier (e.g., $5k/mo) with 15-25% unit cost reduction when using recommended profiles; includes premium support and longer retention in Console analytics.
  - Dedicated Add-on: Customer-specific quantization profiles and priority routing; pricing handled as a dedicated uplift negotiated with sales.

- Billing changes:
  - Introduce 'simulation-credit' SKU to bill cost simulation runs for high-volume customers.
  - Unit price adjustments when using recommended quantization will be reflected as 'effective unit price' on invoices. Finance must review meter definitions (see finance-and-legal/billing).

Launch & Release Notes (GA):
- Redwood Optimize v2 (GA 2026-06-21):
  - New: Automated model & quantization recommendations; workload-aware batching suggestions; cost simulation modal in Console.
  - Improved: Integration with eval harness for regression alerts and quality gates.
  - Fixed: Several performance regressions in continuous-batching for sequences >1024 (eng-serving-runtime/benchmarking-and-perf-suite tracked).

Rollout & Operations:
1. Beta cohort onboarding checklist:
   a) Identify 10 pilot customers (account manager + SE assigned).
   b) Run initial simulation on customer traffic, record predicted delta vs baseline.
   c) Enable recommendations in read-only mode, monitor error/latency/quality signals for 7 days.
   d) If metrics acceptable (cost delta >=12% and quality regressions <=1 point), enable active rollout to 20% traffic.
2. GA rollout: gradual ramp by traffic per-customer with auto-fallback to baseline model if error rate growth >1.5x or P95 latency > target +10%.

SLOs & Monitoring:
- Key SLOs: Recommendation API availability 99.9%, recommendation latency P95 < 250ms for cached workloads, cost simulation job success rate 99%.
- Dashboards: Eng-Platform to add panels under /dashboards/redwood-optimize-v2: adoption, cost-savings distribution, P95 recommendation latency, simulation accuracy.

Success Metrics (90 days post-GA):
- Adoption: 20% active users engaging with recommendations.
- Financial: 8% conversion uplift to paid/committed plans; incremental ARR target $750k within first 6 months.
- Quality: <1.0 point semantic metric regression on monitored prompt sets.

3) GTM to prepare launch materials and pricing page drafts by 2026-05-15.
